name: Dr Rahul Menon
quote: The scope confirms. The history usually points. I'd rather spend the time on the history.
bio: Rahul sees the long tail of digestive symptoms that are common enough to be shrugged off and persistent enough to spoil a life: reflux that returns whenever medication stops, a bowel habit that changed last year, bloating that follows a pattern nobody has asked about.
He performs endoscopy at a partner hospital and will tell you frankly when one is needed and when it isn't. His clinic letters are known among colleagues for their diagrams.
background: Gastroenterology and hepatology training, with an interest in functional gut disorders.
